s2.name: Yakushima
s2.fact: Yakushima (屋久島) is one of the Ōsumi Islands in Kagoshima Prefecture, Japan. The island, 504.88 km2 (194.94 sq mi) in area, has a population of 11,858. It is accessible by hydrofoil ferry, car ferry, or by air to Yakushima Airport.

s3.name: Oenotria Scopuli - False Color
s3.fact: The THEMIS VIS camera contains 5 filters. The data from different filters can be combined in multiple ways to create a false color image. These false color images may reveal subtle variations of the surface not easily identified in a single band image.

deals.reason: the pool shot at crab level: a shell is a stadium and the watching crowd is a skyline
no music was chosen, so the pool's own signature - water slap, shell clatter, grit under claw - carries the film
